newsitem.title: USA: Calif Treasurer says refunding saves state $12 mln.
newsitem.headline: Calif Treasurer says refunding saves state $12 mln.

text.p: California state Treasurer Matt Fong said on Monday that last week's sale of refunding bonds saved taxpayers $11.6 million.
On Friday, the state sold $164 million in state Public Works Board refunding revenue bonds. Details of the deal were not made available until today.
"We watched what was happening in the market and decided to take advantage, and save taxpayers approximately $12 million," Fong said in a statement.
The bonds were sold in a negotiated sale by a team lead by senior underwriter Bear, Stearns & Co Inc.
